_readme: GOLIVE-PREP-1. Data for scripts/golive-swap.js. swapSpots: the 7 values and where each lives (token + marker comment). labels: visible text of the five buy buttons after the swap. flips: the 'not offered / not open yet' lines. Go-live wording is from Legal Mate WILD-GOLIVE-COPY-v1.md, pasted verbatim. The script refuses --write until the 7 live values (5 Payment Links, Discord invite, date) are supplied. Pins use {{new:EDIT_ID}} for the new copy.
